name: CoverPlayer
summary: Offline, cover-first audio player for audiobooks, podcasts, radio plays, and music on Knulli.

notes: User-authorized experimental Knulli package for detected aarch64 glibc systems with a 640x480 through 1280x720 display; no real-device validation is recorded yet.

The reviewed upstream Knulli archive contains the launcher, AArch64 binary, bundled runtime libraries, license files, and an upstream MANIFEST.sha256. GitHub reports release v0.1.0-rc.4 as not immutable. The Store treats the URL as a locator and pins the accepted bytes with the exact size and SHA-256, so a replaced asset cannot install.
The Store owns only /userdata/roms/ports/CoverPlayer and one Ports gamelist entry. It does not adopt or back up other ports in the shared Ports directory.

CoverPlayer stores progress, collections, bookmarks, language, and cache data under /userdata/system/configs/coverplayer. The launcher log is /userdata/system/logs/coverplayer.log. Staging replaces the launcher's /tmp fallback with a same-length fail-closed exit.
The application browses user-selected media under /userdata and does not download remote code. Media directories remain outside the managed package destination.

evidence.note: Version-pinned Knulli ZIP; 3,039,732 bytes compressed, 7,056,515 bytes across extracted regular files, SHA-256 70131f9544ebdcdcde094d2a5d42e394fb00124654bfc7d7dc487572cfa53bb9. Upstream package verification passed for 60 files and 2 manifests.
Apache-2.0 project license reviewed at the tagged release commit; bundled dependency notices are included in the archive.
Upstream identifies Knulli as the primary target and documents Knulli background playback. This catalogue entry does not claim a verified device or firmware matrix.

The launcher installs its bundled library path, sets the SDL preference directory to /userdata/system/configs/coverplayer, and writes /userdata/system/logs/coverplayer.log. Its published fallback to /tmp/coverplayer.log is removed by the declared same-length patch, which exits instead of leaving /userdata.

The release binary is ELF64 AArch64 and requires system SDL2 plus libc/libm/libgcc_s/libstdc++; SDL2_image, SDL2_ttf, mpg123, and their supporting libraries are bundled. Highest observed GLIBC symbol requirement is 2.27.

install.warning: Experimental package: Knulli installation and launch are not yet validated on a real device. The Store owns only this package directory and one Ports menu entry. Other ports are not adopted. Progress stays in /userdata/system/configs/coverplayer.
